szoveg_eredeti:
Perplexity is the best agent orchestrator

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-20T17:20:46+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2123828913994699044; média: videó, 30 másodperc]
Perplexity made this app that lets you draw music with your webcam, inspired by @measure_plan.

It's built with MediaPipe/WASM tracking in a web worker, with multi-frame pinch detection and live smoothing. Each scribble's height sets quantized pitch, and its horizontal position sets loop timing for any of four Web Audio instruments.
